items.text: Aviation careers after a BSc include ground and airport operations, air traffic services, aviation meteorology, cargo and logistics, maintenance support and cabin or customer roles, and eligibility, medical and licensing rules differ sharply by role, so check each one before paying for training.
Verify recognition, check exact eligibility and never pay for guaranteed placements.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
